newsitem.title: UK: Valmet Corp firm to take over Atlas Converting.
newsitem.headline: Valmet Corp firm to take over Atlas Converting.

text.p: Britain's Atlas Converting Equipment Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed with Valmet Converting Plc, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Valmet Corporation, for a takeover of Atlas for 86 million stg in cash.
The offer values each Atlas share at 815 pence.
The offer represents a premium of 26 percent over the closing price of an Atlas share which closed at 647 1/2 pence on June 3, 1997.

"This acquisition brings together a global leader in paper machines, process automation and related services for the pulp and paper industry with Atlas," said Matti Sundberg, chief executive officer of Valmet.
Atlas' chairman Chris Rogers said its merger with Valmet would strengthen its international base.
Valmet has irrevocable undertakings to accept the offer from directors of Atlas representing in aggregate 26 percent of Atlas' issued share capital.
